crossRefs.note: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.
In his name, the nations will hope.”
Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will…
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you…
For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am…
Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…
“I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.
“You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and…
This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last…
Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord…
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through…
comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each…
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
Jesus said to him, “ ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
This is the first and great commandment.
If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
“I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;
but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.
But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the…
For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your…
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having…
who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…
I myself am Yahweh. Besides me, there is no savior.
Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’ ”
Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it…

translations.web: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
translations.bsb: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
translations.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
translations.asv: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He that honoreth not the Son honoreth not the Father that sent him.
